observar.tarjeta.clasica: In the classic view species are grouped by color.
observar.grafico.vacio: The chart appears with the second sample (one every {n} cycles).
observar.grafico.aria: Stacked area chart: bots of each species over the run
observar.ritmo.ayuda: Simulation cycles per second and frames drawn per second
observar.sembrar.ayuda: Add bots of a species to the running world
observar.sembrar.nota: Later you will be able to pick from the bot library.
observar.guardar.ayuda: Save the run in this browser or download the .dbsim file
observar.guardar.explica: It is saved in this browser, with its scenario, seed and events. The last 20 runs and the starred ones are kept. If it was already saved, it is updated.
observar.instantanea.ayuda: World image, snapshot of the living and record of the dead
observar.mejor.ayuda: Selects the fittest bot in the simulation (vegetables do not count)
observar.mejor.ninguno: No candidates: vegetables do not count.
observar.snp.vivos.ayuda: Downloads a record of each living bot: DNA, generation, mutations…
observar.snp.registrar.ayuda: Keeps a record of each bot that dies (live change: kept in the run)
observar.snp.sinVegetales.ayuda: The record of the dead leaves vegetables out (live change: kept in the run)
observar.snp.confirmarReinicio: Delete the {n} accumulated records of dead bots?
observar.snp.error: Could not complete it: try again.
observar.pb.conBot: Aims at the pointer and follows the keys · Esc to exit
observar.pb.elegir: Click a bot to control it · Esc to exit
observar.pb.controlaMas: Controlling {bot} and {n} highlighted bots (children born under control or a marked family)
observar.pb.noReproducible: What you do in this mode is not kept in the run: replicas and «Repeat» do not repeat it.
observar.corridas.ayuda: Resume a saved run or open a .dbsim file
observar.corridas.vacio: You have not saved any run yet.
observar.aviso.podadas: Run “{nombre}” saved. {n} old runs were deleted (the last 20 and the starred ones are kept).
observar.aviso.cargada: Run “{nombre}” loaded: press Start to continue.
observar.aviso.importada: File “{nombre}” loaded: press Start to continue.
observar.aviso.lint: {especie}: {n} DNA words are not recognized and are worth 0.
observar.tarjeta.especies.soloRica: extinctions: only in the rich view
observar.guardar.explicaGuardada: It is saved in this browser, with its scenario, seed and events. You can update the saved run or save it as a new run (which becomes the current one).
observar.guardar.comoNueva.ayuda: Save a separate copy, leaving the saved run as it is
observar.corridas.fallo: Could not read the list of runs.
observar.confirmar.descartar: The current run («{nombre}») has unsaved changes that will be lost. Continue?
observar.aviso.error.desconocido: The operation could not be completed.
observar.aviso.error.inexistente: That run is no longer saved in this browser.
observar.aviso.error.sinDbsim: That run is missing its saved simulation: it cannot be resumed.
observar.aviso.error.dbsimInvalido: The file is not a valid DarwinBots simulation (.dbsim).
observar.aviso.error.conexion.tiempo: The simulation engine took too long to answer.
observar.aviso.error.conexion.worker: The simulation engine hit an error.
observar.aviso.error.conexion.carga: The simulation engine could not be loaded.
observar.aviso.error.conexion.sinRespues: There is no simulation to save.
observar.aviso.error.conexion.saveEmpty: There is no simulation to save.
observar.aviso.error.conexion.otro: The simulation engine could not complete the request.
observar.aviso.error.almacen.versionViej: Another tab opened a newer version of the app: reload this page.
observar.aviso.error.almacen.sinIndexedd: This browser does not allow saving data (IndexedDB is not available).
observar.aviso.error.almacen.otro: Could not read or write the browser storage.
observar.aviso.error.sinAdn: The DNA of «{bot}» was not found.
observar.aviso.error.cuota: The browser storage is full: delete old runs and try again.
observar.tv.pausa.ayuda: Seconds of the break between fights (0 to 60); they apply from the next fight.
observar.tv.salir.ayuda: Turns automatic play off and goes back to the tournament. The fight in play goes on and is recorded when it ends.
observar.tv.paneles.ayuda: Leaves full screen and keeps playing in Observe, with the side panel and the bar.
observar.tv.pantalla.ayuda: Keeps playing in full screen, without panels.
observar.tv.detener.ayuda: Stops playing on its own. The fight in play goes on and is recorded when it ends.
observar.seguirTorneo.ayuda: When this fight ends, keeps going on its own with the tournament's next fights, with a break screen between them.
observar.auto.bloqueado: While the tournament plays on its own the world can't be changed: stop it to use this.
observar.tv.siguienteEdicion: The next edition, with a new draw, starts in {s} s
observar.tv.siguienteEdicionPelea: The next edition, drawing entrants at every fight, starts in {s} s
observar.tv.error.tv-fallos-lanzar: Too many failed launches in a row.
observar.tv.error.tv-fallos-nulos: Too many void fights in a row.
observar.tv.error.tv-abandonado: The fight was abandoned: something else took the simulation.
observar.tv.error.tv-sin-torneo: No tournament is open: pick one in Compete.
